nodes.text:
Scene:
  identity: dense futuristic city block suspended over featureless deep-blue void
  character: stark, unfinished game environment
  light: strong daylight, hard shadows
  organization: highly ordered, tightly packed
Central block:
  base: compact rectangular platform
  count: roughly six closely packed buildings
  alignment: central buildings aligned to the raised road
  between buildings: cramped service courts
Office tower:
  prominence: dominant, tall, square
  façades: repetitive red-brown and glass horizontal bands
  recess: large, dark red, vertical
Other buildings:
  mid rises: several pale concrete structures, strip windows, bright ribbed roofs
  service building: shorter, weathered, rooftop crowded with machinery
Elevated road:
  form: broad elevated concrete roadway
  course: wrapping around two sides of the block in a sweeping right-angle curve
  supports: heavy rectangular piers visibly descending into void
Below road:
  space: narrow shadowy pedestrian or service strip
  enclosure: long green-gray modular noise barriers, concrete retaining walls, bulky column bases, dark doorways
  markings: occasional graffiti
Central rooftop:
  arrangement: dense equipment clusters
  inventory: boxy ventilation units, cylindrical tanks, ducts, grilles, antennas, satellite dishes, cables, pale green rooftop enclosure
Alleys:
  markings: painted yellow hazard markings in the alleys below
  objects: a few tiny utility objects
Enclosing skyline:
  count: many much taller futuristic towers
  position: closely surrounding platform, looming immediately around block
  boundary: towers form scene’s outer edges
  foundations: isolated, narrow void-filled gaps between them
  tower types: cylindrical high-rises with glowing window bands, dark glass slabs with orange accents, rounded white megastructures, angular industrial skyscrapers
